pages.title: Vollzanbel — Hellfire Summoning
pages.text: $(o)Pillars of hellfire erupt at the target.$()

Frieren's hellfire: pillars of fire erupt like molten lava at the target area. Three levels increase damage and radius. Ignites foes; leaves terrain intact. Damage: 2× spell power within 2 + level blocks, and burning for 3 + level seconds.

pages.title: At a glance
pages.text: $(l)School:$() Fire$(br)$(l)Rarity:$() Epic and up$(br)$(l)Levels:$() 3$(br)$(l)Mana:$() 120 (+10 per level)$(br)$(l)Cooldown:$() 15 s$(br)$(l)Cast:$() Long, 2 s$(br)$(l)Effect:$() 2x spell power within 2 + level blocks, burning 3 + level s$(br)$(o)Before gear bonuses: 16.0 at level 1, 28.0 at level 3.$()
